text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following a strong showing in the<n>Japan Cup,
Symboli Rudolf intends to<n>ride her momentum to
the Arima<n>Kinen, where Maruzensky will also be
competing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The news sees Rudolf, who has<n>always been
curious about<n>Maruzensky, set alight with a quiet
determination.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the next generation well on their<n>way to
following in her footsteps,<n>Symboli Rudolf seems
to have less<n>weighing her down than before.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And following Air Groove and her<n>other friends'
requests to race as her<n>true self, she resolves to
run the<n>Arima Kinen not as the Emperor, but
simply as Symboli Rudolf.
